description.zh: 计算器、单位换算、颜色、时间戳、UUID、Base64、哈希，Enter 复制结果
description.en: Calculator, unit conversion, colours, timestamps, UUIDs, Base64 and hashes; Enter copies

hint.en: an expression, or 12 inch to cm

ai.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression (2^10, sqrt(2), (1+2)*3, 80*15%, 5!) or convert units (12 inch to cm, 100 f to c, 1.5 GB in MB, 3 斤 to kg). The first item's title is the result.

description.en: A colour in every notation: HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV

ai.description: Convert a colour between notations: give #rrggbb, #rgb, rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or hsv(); the items are the HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV forms.

description.zh: 时间戳 ⇄ 日期，本地和 UTC
description.en: Timestamps to dates and back, local and UTC

hint.zh: 时间戳或日期；留空看现在
hint.en: a timestamp or a date; empty for now

ai.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) to a date, a date (2024-01-02 15:04:05, ISO 8601) to a timestamp, or give the current time when the query is empty. Items show local time with its UTC offset, UTC and ISO 8601.
Generate a random UUID (version 4). The first item's title is the UUID.
Base64: encodes the text given (UTF-8); when the text is itself Base64 that decodes to text, the first item is the decoded text.

description.en: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 of text or a file

ai.description: Hash text (UTF-8) or a file (give its full path; up to 64 MB). Start the query with md5, sha1 or sha256 to pick one; otherwise all three are returned, each item's title the lower-case hex digest.
